### Fixed
- **The 3.x → 4.x upgrade migrates the storage version of the kagent CRDs, and keeps the hand-created `ModelConfig`s** (giantswarm/agent-platform#396). A cluster that ran kagent 0.10 stores `modelconfigs`, `modelproviderconfigs` and `remotemcpservers.kagent.dev` at `v1alpha2`; the line's `kagent-crds` chart declares `v1alpha3` only, the apiserver refuses the CRD update (`v1alpha2 was previously a storage version, and must remain in spec.versions until a storage migration …`), `kagent-crds` never installs and the connectivity, `substrate` and `kagent` releases behind it never move (found by the migration rehearsal, giantswarm/agentlab#143). Two hook Jobs of the meta chart, as the hook identity in `alpine/k8s`, rendered whenever `components.kagent-crds` is on — with the bundled engine and, the one exception to "no hook without the engine", through a cluster's own Flux, so the cut-over stays "lift the bound and let Flux upgrade" on every installation: `<release>-kagent-storage-version-backup` (`pre-install,pre-upgrade`, weight -7) records every object of each of the three CRDs still stored at `v1alpha2` into ConfigMap `kagent-storage-version-migration` in the kagent namespace (`status` and the server-set metadata stripped; `recorded-at`) and deletes those CRDs, so `kagent-crds` installs them at `v1alpha3`, then — on every run — re-points the three kinds from `kagent.dev/v1alpha2` to `v1alpha3` in every Helm release manifest that still names them (the release Secrets, patched in place: what `helm mapkubeapis` does for a removed API — Helm reads a release's stored manifest back through the cluster's REST mappings on each upgrade, and the 3.x connectivity release's catalog and the kagent 0.x release's default `ModelConfig` and tool-server `RemoteMCPServer` otherwise fail with `unable to build kubernetes objects from current release manifest: no matches for kind "RemoteMCPServer" in version "kagent.dev/v1alpha2"`, as the lab showed); `<release>-kagent-storage-version-restore` (`post-install,post-upgrade`, weight 0) waits for `modelconfigs.kagent.dev` to be Established serving `v1alpha3` (up to 8 min — under a cluster's own Flux the post hooks run before `kagent-crds` has installed) and re-creates every recorded `ModelConfig` no Helm release owned at `kagent.dev/v1alpha3` with name, namespace, labels, annotations and `spec` unchanged (the spec is identical in both versions), leaves one that is already present to its owner, fails the upgrade on any other refusal, and marks the ConfigMap `restored-at` so it runs once (a `ModelConfig` removed by hand after the cut-over must not come back). The chart-rendered `ModelConfig`s come back from their releases, model-manager's from model-manager; `RemoteMCPServer`s and `ModelProviderConfig`s are recorded, never restored — the 4.x charts render their own. A CRD that is absent or stores `v1alpha3` is left alone: a fresh install and a second run change nothing (the ATS smoke sees the hooks do nothing). The hook identity `<release>-hooks` is created for the hooks' events too (`agent-platform.hooks.serviceAccountEvents` composes them) and, without the engine, for those alone. `make verify-kagent-storage-version` asserts the pair, the scripts, the identity's events, the engine-off render and the kagent-off render; `verify-engine` / `verify-self` carry the family in their expected hook sets. UPGRADE.md "3.x → 4.0 (the kagent line)" has the operator's side: what comes back and from where, the downtime window, the record and when to delete it.
